<arc/>Lightning Grenades release an additional lightning bolt. (4🠚5)

<arc/>Pulse Grenades release an additional 2 pulses. (6🠚8)

<arc/>Storm Grenades release a third volley, dealing the same damage as the second volley. 

When combined with the <arc/>Touch of Thunder titan aspect, Storm Grenade's Roaming Storm lasts 1.5 seconds longer. (4🠚5.5s)
